bodyHtml:
Collar City 2 - 0 Spindles

The Spins killed their chance to go 3 wins in a row on Tuesday night against Collar City FC.

After failing to finish several chances in the first 15, Collar City found the net for their first two chances of the match.

2-0 at halftime.

After another slow half in the second, Spindles failed to find the net once with several clear chances.

2-0 was the final score at Nott Road.

Not good enough from Spindles.

All eyes toward Saturday for the club's first-ever Grassroots Cup at Lansing Park.

We will see you there.
